description: When the board is reached through a configured --public-url gateway (for example from a phone), browser routes return raw JSON (`{"code":"ORIGIN_REJECTED","error":"Open the configured client address"}` or `"Origin not allowed"`). The browser renders it as a JSON document.
expected: A small HTML page for browser navigations: "Pardner's board opens only on the computer running it. Phone access isn't available yet."
actual: Raw JSON with a Pretty-print checkbox.
suggested_fix: Content-negotiate ORIGIN_REJECTED: return a minimal HTML explanation when Accept includes text/html.

description: Nothing in the running product says phone access is not offered. The LAN attempt fails at the network layer, and the answer exists only in the README.
expected: A short line in the profile or Invite area ("Use Pardner on this computer; phone access isn't available yet"), so the person learns this before trying.
suggested_fix: Add the sentence to the You profile's Devices section.
